description.zh:
需要绑定的别名。

一次最多只能绑定10个，多个alias用逗号分隔，alias最长128个字节（中文算三个字节），一个设备最多绑定128个别名，一个别名最多允许绑定128个设备。
description.en:
The alias to attach.

You can attach up to 10 aliases in one request. Separate multiple aliases with commas. Each alias can be up to 128 bytes long. Chinese characters count as three bytes each. A device can have up to 128 aliases attached. An alias can be attached to up to 128 devices.

description.zh: 设备在推送的唯一标识，32位，数字和小写字母组合。
description.en: The unique identifier of the device in Mobile Push. It is 32 characters long and contains only numbers and lowercase letters.

descriptions.zh: 一次最多绑定10个别名，绑定之后立即生效。
descriptions.en: You can attach up to 10 aliases in a single request. The attachment takes effect immediately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun push bind-alias --app-key 23267207 --device-id e2ba19de97604f55b165576730000 --alias-name test_alias --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun push BindAlias --region cn-hangzhou --DeviceId e2ba19de97604f55b165576730000 --AppKey 23267207 --AliasName test_alias
